कुरंगः (गी f.)
1 A deer in
general; तन्मे ब्रूहि कुरंग कुत्र भवता किं नाम
तप्तं तपः Śānti. 1. 14, 4. 6; लवंगी
कुरंगीदृगंगीकरोतु Jag.
--2 A species of
deer (कुरंग ईषत्ताम्रः स्याद्धरिणाकृतिको
महान्).
--Comp.
--अक्षी --नयना,
--नेत्रा a deer-eyed woman.
--नाभिः

कुरुः (pl.)
1 N. of a country
situated in the north of India about
the site of the modern Delhi; श्रियः
कुरूणामधिपस्य पालनीं

; चिराय
तस्मिन् कुरवश्चकासते 1. 17.
--2 The
kings of this country.
--रुः
1 A
priest.
--2 Boiled rice.
--Comp.
--क्षेत्रं N. of an extensive plain near
Delhi, the scene of the great war
between the Kauravas and
Pāṇḍavas; धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः

.
--क्षेत्रियोगः a
solar day in the course of which
three lunar days, three asterisms
and three yogas occur.
--चिल्लः a
crab.
--जांगलं = कुरुक्षेत्र q. v.
--राज्
m.,
--राजः an epithet of
Duryodhana.
--विस्तः a weight of gold
[]
equal to about 700 Troy grains.
--वृद्धः an epithet of Bhīṣma.

कुरुंटः A red species of amaranth.
--टी
1 A wooden doll or puppet.
--2
The wife of a Brāhmaṇa or teacher.

कुरुरी A kind of bird (having a
plaintive tone); cf. कुररी.

कुरुलः A lock of hair, especially

कुरुविंदः, --दं A ruby.
--दं

--2 A mirror.

1 A painting brush or
pencil.
--2 A key.
--3 A bud, blossom.
--4 Inspissated milk.
--5 A needle.

कूर्द् {c1c} U. (कूर्दति-ते, कूर्दित)
1 To
leap, jump.
--2 To frolic;
वव्रश्चुराजुघूर्णुश्च स्येमुश्चुकूर्दिरे तथा

कुर्वत् pres. p. Doing &c. --m.
1 A servant.
--2 A shoemaker.

कूर्चः, --र्चं
1 A bunch of any
thing, a bundle.
--2 A handful of
Kuśa grass.
--3 A peacock's feather
--4 The beard; आगतमनध्यायकारणं
सिवेशषभूतमद्य जीर्णकूर्चानां

--5 The tip of
the thumb and the middle finger
brought in contact so as to pinch &c.
--6 The upper part of the rose, the
part (or hair) between the eye-brows.
--7 A brush.
--8 Deceit, fraud.
--9

--10 Hypocrisy.
--र्चः
1 The head.
--2 A store-room.
--Comp.
--शिरस् n. the upper part of the

--शीर्षः,
--शेखरः the cocoa-nut tree.

कूर्मः [कौ जले ऊर्मिर्वेगोऽस्य पृषो˚ Tv.]
1
A tortoise; गूहेत्कूर्म इवांगानि
[]
रक्षेद्विवरमात्मनः

.
--2
Viṣṇu in his second or Kūrma
incarnation.
--3 One of the outer
winds of the body.
--4 A particular
gesticulation with the fingers.
--र्मी
A female tortoise.
--Comp.
--अवतारः
the Kūrma incarnation of Viṣṇu;
cf.

:
--क्षितिरतिविपुलतरे तव
तिष्ठति पृष्ठे धरणिधरणकिणचक्रगरिष्ठे । केशव
धृतकच्छपरूप जय जगदीश हरे ॥.
--पृष्ठं
--पृष्ठकं {1} the back or shell of a
tortoise. {2} a lid or cover of a dish.
--राजः Viṣṇu in the shape of a
tortoise in his second incarnation.

कुरुक्षेत्र N. of an extensive region or plain near Delhi;
the scene of the great war between the Pāṇḍavas
and Kauravas. It is the tract near the holy lake
called by the same name lying to the south of
Thāneshvar, and extended from the south of the
Sarasvatī to the north of the Dṛṣadvatī. It is
sometimes called समंतपंचक the tract of the ‘five
pools’ of blood of the Kṣatriyas slain by
Paraśurāma.
